cards.review_notes: Check the original June 7, 2026 church post: dates, activities and hours were readable only through https://www.findglocal.com/US/Burnsville/127211731037834/Browns-Creek-Baptist-Church. Its post says June 14–19, 5:45–8:15 PM; third-party event listings instead end at 8:30 PM. The year comes from the mirrored post date and is corroborated by the 2026 event title. The church's indexed Facebook Trunk-or-Treat post and mirrored profile publish 100 Lower Browns Creek Road; the NC Baptist directory lists 76 Lower Browns Creek Rd. Confirm the current drop-off address. The VBS post says all ages and dinner served every night starting at 5:45 PM, but gives no numeric youth age range or lunch information.
